evals.prompt: Create a skill called 'changelog-writer' that turns git history into a release notes file.
evals.expected_output: Agent drafts a SKILL.md (name, pushy description with when-to-trigger branches, workflow with completion criteria) following the craft rules: deliberate invocation, information hierarchy, leading words, pruning. No eval/benchmark assumptions.

evals.prompt: Why doesn't my skill trigger when the user asks for a 'review'?
evals.expected_output: Agent applies the skill-creator craft: diagnoses the description as the trigger, suggests adding the 'review' branch and pushier wording, possibly a should-trigger/should-not-trigger eval set. Does not rewrite unrelated content.

evals.prompt: Improve this skill and optimize its description.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the draft->test->evaluate->iterate->package workflow, then an opt-in description trigger-eval pass (should-trigger + should-not-trigger), and reports scores before/after.
